F10, F24: channel return rights or bill-and-hold arrangements exist and revenue is a critical audit matter, giving room for premature or channel-stuffed revenue that fits the receivables build-up.
R19, R08, R10: operating cash flow is only 0.42x net income and accruals are positive (TATA/RSST 0.03), so earnings quality is weak.
R09, R17: Beneish M-score of -1.84 sits just below the -1.78 manipulation threshold; Dechow F-score of 0.49 is below 1.0, which is reassuring.

F22, F24, R03, R13: a major acquisition with business-combination and goodwill/intangibles CAMs, rising asset quality index (1.24) and a high soft-asset share (0.73) leave room for purchase accounting and impairment judgments.
F27, R02, R12: a significant inventory writedown, worsening gross margin (GMI 1.06) and inventory growing despite falling sales point to demand weakness and possible valuation risk.

F01, F03, F07, F14-F19, F21: no material weakness, an unqualified ICFR opinion, no restatement, no management turnover, no investigations or litigation and no capital raise, all of which lower the risk.
